Do you have decreased vision in either eye?

Do you have a drooping eyelid or a difference in pupil size?
Do you have a severe headache, dizziness, weakness, numbness, or difficulty speaking?
Have you recently injured your head or eyes?
Have you had similar episodes before?
Do the symptoms worsen when you are tired or looking in a particular direction?
